rubric: Respond to the actual conversational obligation
Do not ask again for supplied information
Do not invent material action details
Natural brief wording without a repetitive service opener
Use memories without treating them as permission

messages: hey
cases.expected: Brief natural greeting; no compulsory help question or menu.

messages: hey, it's Snow White laundry in Indiranagar
cases.expected: Continue the existing question; do not reset to a generic greeting, and don't ask whether the uniquely named laundry is the one.
